hero.title: Sanskriti University
hero.summary: Sanskriti University’s School of Agriculture combines degree teaching with an ecological farming centre at its Mathura campus. Its 2026-27 brochure lists undergraduate agriculture and postgraduate agronomy and horticulture, allowing applicants to compare broad agricultural training with more specialised study.

overview.heading: Agriculture teaching alongside an ecological farming centre
paragraphs: The School of Agriculture describes laboratory experiments as a regular part of its teaching. It also reports a Centre of Excellence on Ecological Farming under the guidance of the Process and Products Development Centre associated with MSME. The centre’s stated remit includes sustainable practices and farm mechanisation training for students and farmers.

For costs and entry rules, the dated brochure is more useful than older course pages. The 2026-27 brochure lists a four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and two-year postgraduate options in agronomy and horticulture. An older undergraduate page displays a lower annual figure, so this profile follows the explicitly dated brochure rather than silently mixing prices.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: Sanskriti publishes an admission-procedure page and links its application portal. Use the 2026-27 brochure for the programme-specific academic threshold and request the selection and document requirements for the intended course.
eligibility_points: B.Sc. Agriculture: 10+2 PCM, PCB or Agriculture with 50% aggregate in the 2026-27 brochure.
Postgraduate agronomy and horticulture: relevant graduation with 50% aggregate in that brochure.

steps.title: Confirm the course
steps.text: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake.

steps.title: Request the intake notice
steps.text: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

documents: Signed admission form and proof of date of birth.
Class X and XII certificates/mark sheets; graduation or postgraduate records where applicable.
Medical-fitness certificate from an MBBS or equivalent practitioner, and Aadhaar.
Originals and three photocopy sets; ten applicant and four parent passport-size photographs.
Prescribed result-awaited undertaking when applicable; anti-ragging undertakings at course registration.

campus.heading: Ecological farming and subject laboratories
campus.intro: The school’s official account identifies subject laboratories and an ecological farming centre. Its description links the centre to training in sustainable farming and mechanisation; it does not document an identical practical timetable for every cohort.

facilities.name: Agriculture subject laboratories
facilities.description: The school describes experiments supported by subject laboratories and technicians.

facilities.name: Centre of Excellence on Ecological Farming
facilities.description: The centre is described as a training resource for students and farmers.

student_services.name: Separate residential hostels
student_services.description: The university describes separate hostels for boys and girls, with cleaning and maintenance provision. A room offer and its applicable charges require written confirmation.

student_services.name: Campus and hostel safety
student_services.description: Its infrastructure account describes a secured campus boundary and measures restricting unauthorised entry.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: Sanskriti’s undated scholarship policy describes general categories including sports, defence, girls and disability. Its published conditions limit awards to tuition, allow one scheme at a time and require academic continuation without back papers. Agriculture applicants should obtain a dated programme-specific award; engineering and MBA merit tables are not agriculture entitlements.

schemes.name: General-category scholarship conditions (undated)
schemes.details: The page lists defence, girls, disability and sports categories, with supporting-proof requirements. Only one scheme may apply, tuition-only limits and continuation conditions apply, and the stated exclusions include BAMS, BUMS, B.Sc. Nursing and Ph.D. Agriculture-specific current approval is still required.

faqs.question: What annual agriculture fee does Sanskriti publish for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The dated brochure lists INR 90,000 annually for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. This is not a full living-cost budget.

faqs.question: Which 10+2 subject combinations are accepted?
faqs.answer: The 2026-27 brochure lists PCM, PCB or Agriculture, with a minimum 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: Does Sanskriti offer postgraduate agricultural study?
faqs.answer: The brochure lists two-year M.Sc. options in Agronomy and Horticulture.

faqs.question: What is the ecological farming centre?
faqs.answer: The school describes a centre working under PPDC/MSME guidance for training related to sustainable practices and mechanisation.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR entry automatically cover the M.Sc. programmes?
faqs.answer: No. The audited School of Agriculture row explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.
